# ArtifactFlow

> ArtifactFlow is a self-hosted, versioned artifact vault for tools and documents created with AI.

ArtifactFlow preserves the output, not the conversation. It keeps the authoritative source or normalized original, immutable content versions, searchable content, ownership, permissions, safe previews, and audit history. It is not agent memory, a vector database, a chat archive, an AI generator, or a static site generator.

The current public alpha supports Markdown pages with Mermaid diagrams, self-contained HTML artifacts, and normalized PNG/JPEG images. It searches authoritative text and metadata, keeps retained versions, and exposes approved read and write operations through scoped MCP access. Searchable PDF and Word document artifacts are the next product focus. Untrusted HTML executes only on a separate cookieless artifact origin; image uploads are decoded in a dedicated parser service and only normalized pixels are retained. The security page and threat model document these boundaries and their residual risks.

## Product

- [Home](https://artifactflow.app/): Product overview, current screenshots, capabilities, alpha status, and project boundaries.
- [Artifact workflow](https://artifactflow.app/workflow/): Stable identity, immutable content versions, draft lifecycle state, metadata changes, and format-specific payloads.
- [Security architecture](https://artifactflow.app/security/): Two-origin isolation, sandbox and CSP controls, signed previews, defense in depth, and residual risks.
- [MCP server](https://artifactflow.app/mcp/): Current operations, token scopes, authority limits, untrusted-data envelopes, and write safeguards.
- [Self-hosting](https://artifactflow.app/self-hosting/): Local evaluation and production requirements for origins, runtime roles, PostgreSQL, storage, secrets, and mail.
- [Product roadmap](https://artifactflow.app/roadmap/): Current alpha boundary, post-alpha and beta candidates, required proof, and explicit non-promises.

## Guides

- [What is an AI artifact vault?](https://artifactflow.app/guides/ai-artifact-vault/): A practical definition, essential properties, current ArtifactFlow scope, and links to lifecycle evidence.
- [How should AI-generated HTML run safely?](https://artifactflow.app/guides/safe-ai-generated-html/): The two-origin boundary, sandbox and CSP layers, advisory scanning, and documented residual risks.
- [Where should AI-generated artifacts live?](https://artifactflow.app/guides/ai-artifact-storage/): A comparison of AI chat, shared drives, Git, static hosting, and a versioned artifact vault.

- [Operations guide](https://github.com/Gadsotek/artifactflow/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): Production configuration, deployment, backup, restore, and release operations.
